outcome: serum levels of inflammatory cytokines (IL-4, IL-6, IL-8, TNF-a, interferon-gamma, IL-1 alpha, IL-1 beta, IL-2, IL-10)
cohort: The study included 40 pregnant women with intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy (ICP) and 40 age-matched healthy pregnant women as controls.
finding: Levels of IL-4, IL-6, and TNF-a were significantly lower, while IL-8 was significantly higher in ICP subjects compared with controls, and combining TNF-a, IL-4, and IL-8 analyses increased performance for ICP identification.
